attributes.title: Keyframes

lesson.concept: Intermediate values are part of the design
lesson.why: The morph follows explicit rotation, scale and lift arrays. An easing curve controls progress through those targets; changing duration alone should retime the same running loop.
lesson.experiment: Compare Helicopter and Moon hop. Change lift while the loop runs and watch the existing shape rather than a reset copy.
lesson.pitfall: A multi-target keyframe animation cannot simply be switched to a two-target spring generator.
lesson.combine: Combine with SVG path drawing for a synchronized shape and line treatment.
